answer: Progressive operator tax blocks bulk fakes. An operator files a fable listing its identities; each locks 80 key-bound credits. Tax rises with operator count: identity k pays 20+10(k-1) credits, so 1000 fakes pay 5015000 sunk tax plus 80000 locked bonds, a quadratic total. An honest operator pays 20 once and locks 80 once, refunded after a clean epoch. Payments post to the voyage ledger, so anyone can recompute count and tax due. A gale audit traces funding graphs; splitting across fake operators fails because linked funding merges them and burns undeclared bonds.
